comments.author: Chris J. Kiick
comments.html:
How about adding one more rule for testing:
Every bug should have a test case.
This closes the loop between QE/QA, maintainers and developers. Every time a bug is closed, there ought to be an addition to the test cases that specifically tests that particular bug fix.

comments.author: ahl
comments.html:
Hey Chris,
I should have been more explicit, but that's exactly what I had in mind with that second point: every time we putback a fix, we also putback one or more tests to verify it. As you've identified, this closes the loop and protects against regressions.
